subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan SKILL.md detection outside configured skill roots, and should that run in skills check, Doctor, status, or startup?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and operator-noise behavior, so maintainer product intent is needed before implementation.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and clear remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

options.title: Also Warn At Status Or Startup
options.body: Surface the same warning during status or startup, accepting broader runtime scanning and more operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and clear remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent product-boundary trail for skills lifecycle, skill-creator, and diagnostic surfaces.
